resources.description: 5-minute grid, 196 days, timezone Europe/Madrid; Parquet twin: harmonized/rce_2025.parquet

fields.name: system
fields.description: RCE (single prototype 2019-2024; unsuffixed tags in 2025), RCE-a, RCE-b

fields.name: operated
fields.description: flow_rce_l_min > 0.05 L/min in at least one unflagged interval; empty without usable flow

fields.name: flow_period
fields.description: when water circulated: day (08:00-18:59 only), night, day+night, none; empty without usable flow; not the physical mode

fields.name: campaign_evidence
fields.description: 2019-2020 test campaigns of the laboratory test programme that cover the day (mode, season, flow), ';'-separated

fields.name: exp_type
fields.description: experiment type 1-4 where the laboratory diary describes the day, else 'unknown'

fields.name: exp_confidence
fields.description: high (type named literally in the diary), medium, low; empty when unknown

fields.name: diary_flag
fields.description: unreliable (period declared unreliable in the diary), event, or empty

fields.name: notes
fields.description: diary notes, campaign matches, known events

fields.name: tanks_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'tanks' group

fields.name: circuit_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'circuit' group

fields.name: surface_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'surface' group

fields.name: flow_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'flow' group

fields.name: pressure_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'pressure' group

fields.name: ambient_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'ambient' group

fields.name: solar_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'solar' group

fields.name: ir_pct
fields.description: share of intervals with at least one unflagged value of the 'ir' group

fields.name: max_gap_min
fields.description: longest run of empty intervals, minutes

fields.name: out_of_range_n
fields.description: values outside the reference ranges of variable_map.yaml

fields.name: codes_removed_n
fields.description: error codes and placeholders removed before averaging

fields.name: suspect_sensors
fields.description: variables with at least half of their values flagged that day, ',' separated

fields.name: validity_checked
fields.description: a WinCC export with the Validity column covers the day

resources.name: quality-cell-flags

fields.name: flag
fields.description: scada_invalid, frozen, definition_differs, zero or stuck (docs/methodology.md)

resources.description: values present in harmonized/ that should not be read as measurements; Parquet twin quality/cell_flags.parquet

fields.name: affects
fields.description: all, control or a canonical variable

fields.name: raw_file
fields.description: published file in raw/ that contributed values

fields.name: sanitized
fields.description: metadata removed from an Office file
